description: This PHP file defines the TimesheetActionLogModel class, which models a timesheet action log in the OrangeHRM system. It implements serialization and normalization for API responses, mapping an underlying entity to a structured data format with defined attributes and filters.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLogModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing and normalizing timesheet action log data for API responses, representing the entity with attributes like action, comment, date, and performed employee details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with the entity and configures available filters and attribute mappings.
